resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: Verifier B is correct — public docs confirm free non-commercial use after registration and that commercial use may need agreement, but do not publish a fixed free-tier hourly quota; the original’s “rate limits apply (see rate_limits)” plus any implied 500/hr is not officially documented. rate_limits: Verifier B is correct — official AirNow API docs do not state a public fixed “500 requests per hour per API key”; that figure is unconfirmed folklore; prefer stating that limits are not published on public docs and must be verified in the account portal or with AirNow. Evidence: https://docs.airnowapi.org and related FAQ/usage pages.
free_tier_limits: Free for non-commercial use after registration; commercial use may require agreement. Specific hourly/request quotas are not published on public docs.
rate_limits: Not publicly documented as a fixed 500 requests/hour per API key; verify limits in the AirNow API account portal or contact AirNow.
